announcements.headline: BioInvent's BI-1808 and KEYTRUDA® Induce Durable Responses in Heavily Pretreated Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer
announcements.insight: Clinical data for BI-1808 combined with KEYTRUDA shows durable responses in ovarian cancer. This follows the CFO retirement announcement, indicating continued operational focus.
